subject: Amendment Required for Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

Please review the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.

We found the following discrepancies that must be amended:
- Consignee: Shipping Instruction = EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC | draft Bill of Lading = UAB NOVAKOPA
- Notify Party: Shipping Instruction = EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC | draft Bill of Lading = UAB NOVAKOPA

Please update the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
